_comment: Image library for Luxe Beauty Trip newsletters. The lbt-newsletter agent reads this to insert real hosted images instead of upload placeholders. Add an entry whenever you add an image the newsletters should be able to use. Keep it in sync with what is actually live at base_url.

logo.note: Header logo. Set width only, let height scale. Never force height.

strip.note: Optional 3-across image strip near the footer.

rules: Every src must be an absolute HTTPS URL. Never a local path.
If an asset ratio is within about 10 percent of the slot ratio, set the slot width and height as given.
If it is further off, set width only and recompute height from the asset natural ratio. Do not force both dimensions, it squishes the photo.
Match by tags first, then by desc. If nothing scores a clear match for a slot, leave the upload placeholder for that slot rather than forcing a weak image.
Prefer assets whose bytes are under about 1 MB for email. Flag anything larger in the placeholder notes so Sophia can swap a lighter copy.
Always use the asset alt text, or tighten it to the section context.
